jobs.employer_name: GBA Gesellschaft für Bioanalytik mbH - HH
jobs.description:
The GBA Group is an international life sciences service provider delivering analytical, logistical, and specialized solutions to the pharmaceutical, medical device, cosmetics, chemical, food, drinking water, and environmental industries.

Our success is built on the expertise, collaboration, and commitment of our people. We foster an inclusive and supportive environment where teamwork, continuous learning, and professional development go hand in hand. Whether you are an experienced specialist or an aspiring leader, you'll find opportunities to grow your career, broaden your expertise, and make a meaningful impact. Together, we drive scientific excellence and shape the future of life sciences.

#TeamChemistry #ScienceWithPassion #GrowingTogether #JoinTheTeam

Responsibilities

- You define the site's scientific strategy, provide toxicology leadership, and advise senior management on scientific and business opportunities.
- You translate the scientific strategy into operational excellence while ensuring GxP, DIN EN ISO/IEC 17025, and regulatory compliance.
- You ensure that SOPs, computerized systems, CAPA processes, and scientific integrity support compliant and high-quality study execution.
- You collaborate with Quality, regulatory authorities, customers, and internal stakeholders to ensure scientific excellence and regulatory compliance.
- You support customer relationships, business development, global collaboration, and the Preclinical Business Unit.
- You lead, coach, and develop a team of Study Directors while fostering a high-performance culture.
- You act as Deputy Test Facility Manager and ensure operational continuity during the Test Facility Manager's absence.

Requirements

- You hold a degree in Toxicology and ideally possess ERT certification.
- You have 10+ years of leadership experience, CRO toxicology expertise, and genetic toxicology knowledge.
- You have in-depth knowledge of GxP, DIN EN ISO/IEC 17025, regulatory requirements, and quality management systems.
- You demonstrate scientific writing, analytical thinking, strategic thinking, and scientific credibility.
- You communicate confidently with customers, regulatory authorities, international stakeholders, and demonstrate excellent stakeholder management.
- You are an inspiring leader with strong people management, organizational, and decision-making skills.
- You are fluent in German (C2) and English ( at least B2) and are willing to travel for business purposes.

Benefits

- You’ll become part of a highly motivated team within a dynamically growing corporate group.
- In our forward-looking industry, you can expect challenging tasks, projects, and regular team events.
- With us, you’ll have the opportunity to work from home a day per week.
- We’ll credit your Givve Card with €40 each month and provide supplemental health insurance through the company.
- You’ll benefit from “Corporate Benefits,” a portal offering various employee perks.
- We also offer a 20% match to your company pension plan.

Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 78,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

ContiTech is one of the world’s leading material experts for industry applications. The Continental group sector offers its customers reliable, safe and convenient industry and service solutions using a range of materials for off-highway applications, on rails and roads, in the air, under and above the ground, in industrial environments, for the food sector and the furniture industry. With about 20,000 employees (Status as of March 2026) at more than 60 sites globally, and sales of some 6.0 billion euros (2025), the global industrial partner is active with core branches in Asia, Europe and North and South America.

Job Description

We're looking for a motivated Antitrust Compliance Specialist (m/f/diverse) who is passionate about antitrust compliance and eager to contribute to global initiatives, foster knowledge sharing, and support the ongoing development of our compliance framework.

Your tasks will include the following activities:

- Taking an active role in enhancing and continuously improving ContiTech’s compliance program, particularly with respect to antitrust compliance
- Identifying opportunities to further strengthen the antitrust compliance program through active collaboration and communication with the regions
- Enhancing the concept for association activities and serving as the point of contact for related inquiries from all stakeholders
- Further developing the global antitrust risk assessment process and acting as the point of contact for antitrust-related questions
- Drafting, reviewing, and updating group policies and guidelines related to antitrust compliance
- Managing the rollout of global antitrust initiatives
- Developing content for antitrust training and other preventive measures in close collaboration with relevant departments
- Delivering antitrust training to all ContiTech business areas and central functions
- Designing and implementing additional mitigation measures, such as internal controls and monitoring activities
- Leading lessons-learned projects and driving ongoing improvements to the effectiveness of the antitrust Compliance Management System (CMS)
- Monitoring regulatory developments, best practices, industry trends, and compliance-related topics
- Developing and maintaining a knowledge-sharing concept for antitrust compliance, ensuring that all materials remain relevant and up to date
- Responding to external third-party audits of the ContiTech compliance program

Qualifications

- Qualification as a fully qualified lawyer (First and Second State Examination) is required
- Several years of professional experience in antitrust law and/or compliance, preferably gained in an international company, law firm, or auditing firm
- Additional experience in anti-money laundering (AML) is considered an advantage
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
- Business-fluent German and English language skills, both written and spoken; additional language skills are a plus
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills combined with a collaborative and team-oriented mindset
- Strong intercultural competence and experience working across functions and international corporate structures
- Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style
- Willingness to travel internationally

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

The well-being of our employees is important to us. That's why we offer exciting career prospects and support you in achieving a good work-life balance with additional benefits such as:

- Training opportunities
- Mobile and flexible working models
- Sabbaticals

and much more...

Sounds interesting for you? Click here to find out more. (https://www.continental.com/en/career/working-at-continental/benefits/)

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging (https://www.continental.com/en/career/working-at-continental/corporate-culture-values/diversity/) are important to us and make our company strong and successful. We offer equal opportunities to everyone - regardless of age, gender, nationality, cultural background, disability, religion, ideology or sexual orientation.

IT Coordinator Europe, Wilhelmsen Ships Service GmbH

Do you want to work for the most ambitious company in the international maritime industry challenging the status quo and help to drive the maritime industry and beyond?

Founded in Norway in 1861, Wilhelmsen is now a comprehensive global maritime group providing over half of the merchant fleet with essential products and services, along with supplying crew and technical management to the largest and most complex vessels ever to sail. Committed to shaping the maritime industry, we also seek to explore and develop new opportunities within the renewables, offshore and energy industries. Supporting a diverse and inclusive workplace, with thousands of colleagues in more than 70 countries, we take competence, sustainability, innovation, and unparalleled customer experiences one step further.

The position:

We are looking for an IT Coordinator who will be joining our Global Business Services division.

Global Business Services provides high quality, scalable and cost-efficient business support services, such as finance, HR and IT, to companies in the Wilhelmsen group.

What you will be doing:

We believe in proactive IT Support and want to empower our users with good knowledge of the tools they need to use to perform their job. In addition to the Microsoft 365 applications, we utilize the functionalities in ServiceNow to automate as much as possible, leaving our team to focus on user interaction, along with technical issues that may require physical attention.

We also have high focus on providing great service, so monitoring user satisfaction and identifying improvement potential is an integral part of this role. We have a 1st Line support team, that also needs guidance on how to support our users in the best way.

Next to 2nd line IT tasks this role will also coordinate local activities and projects related to implementation of new business applications, infrastructure changes as well as management of local IT vendors.

About the department:

The IT Coordinators are part of the User Experience team. Divided in an IT Coordinators West and East Team, providing our 2nd line and proactive services towards our internal and external customers.

In this role you become member of our User Experience West team, which is part of a global team, having colleagues not just in Europe but all over the world!

Who you are:

Are you highly motivated by helping people improve their IT knowledge on the latest Microsoft 365 tools?

Would you like to work in an international environment, where English is the corporate language, utilizing the very latest Modern Workplace technology and applications?

If so, you could be part of our team!

Classified as Internal - This content is proprietary information intended for employees and partners only.

Required experience and skills:

•Excellent written and spoken English and German skills as well as the ability to understand & convey complex IT Scenarios

•A service minded attitude and the ability to communicate with all levels within the business

•A high-level degree in IT or Business Administration or relevant industry experience.

•A driver license

What we offer:

•A fulltime (38,5 hours) as well as permanent contract

•Flexibility in working location

•An attractive salary package

•A laptop and mobile phone

•We offer bike-leasing

•You enjoy 30 annual vacation days

•An open, Scandinavian-influenced culture

Applying:

If you think you have what it takes to excel in this role, please apply online through our career portal by creating a ‘Candidate Home’ account. Here you can upload your resume in English, your salary expectations and your motivational letter including your earliest start date.

www.wilhelmsen.com/careers/

Testia GmbH is a leading company in the Aerospace Sector and part of the global Airbus Group. With over 30 years of experience, we rely on specialized inspection and testing methods as well as innovative solutions to ensure the highest standards in Quality Assurance and Maintenance. Through our international network, we are a key partner for the entire industry.

Testia Hamburg is a central hub for our aerospace services. We directly support key clients like Airbus and collaborate closely with regional small and medium-sized enterprises. Our location is not only strategically important but a hub where highly skilled teams actively shape the future of aviation.

The main activities at the Hamburg site include:

- Inspection and testing methods: Developing and applying state-of-the-art quality assurance techniques.
- Knowledge transfer: Providing expertise in non-destructive testing (NDT) and other innovative technologies through our in-house academy.

Hamburg is not only strategically important due to its proximity to Airbus but also serves as a hub where highly skilled teams work together to actively shape the future of aerospace.

As an NDT Specialist (Non-Destructive Testing), you ensure the safety and integrity of critical components, making you an essential guarantor for flight safety.

Your Tasks and Goals

- Execution of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) according to the highest aviation standards.
- Focus on Level 2 Testing in the following, critical procedures for us: Ultrasonic Testing (UT) per EN 4179 / NAS410, Eddy Current Testing (ET) per EN 4179 / NAS410, X-ray Testing (RT) per EN 4179 / NAS410
- Meticulous documentation and evaluation of measurement results for the preparation of substantiated test reports.

Your Expertise

- Completed qualification as a Materials Tester in NDT according to EN4179/NAS410.
- Proof of a Level 2 Certification in the procedures Ultrasonic, Eddy Current, or X-ray Testing. At least one procedure is mandatory.
- Proof of the required experience periods per procedure as mandated by EN 4179.
- Advanced German knowledge and Intermediate English knowledge.
- Systematic, meticulous, and independent way of working.
- Strong teamwork, resilience, and flexibility.
- Willingness to work in shifts.

Our Benefits

- Professional development in an international and growing company providing strong career opportunities
- International environment with employees from over 20+ countries
- Salary: Competitive, and based on experience.
- Extensive employee benefits within the Testia Group:
- Company Pension Scheme
- Employee Discounts
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan
- International Mobility
- And more from the Airbus Group

If you're passionate about contributing to the future of aerospace and are ready to take on exciting challenges, we look forward to receiving your application and welcoming you to our team at Testia GmbH.

Hydropower Planning Expert (m/f/d)
Lahmeyer International GmbH is a leading international engineering company specializing in planning and consulting for energy, hydropower and irrigation systems. They stand for experience, quality and global expertise, supporting complex projects from development and planning through to operation, backed by the latest technical methods. Their multidisciplinary team combines comprehensive expertise with local practice to deliver efficient, seamless solutions for complex water resource projects.

What you can achieve with us:
• You take the lead in planning hydropower projects, overseeing everything from site selection and layout optimization to the preliminary design of hydraulic structures
• You develop conceptual feasibility studies for dams, waterways, and powerhouses

• You carry out risk assessments and scenario analyses for project alternatives, considering factors such as climate resilience and sedimentation impacts

• Contributing to business development, you prepare proposals and support strategic initiatives in hydropower planning

What convinces us:
• You hold a degree in Civil Engineering (master’s or higher) or a related field – specialization in hydraulic engineering, hydropower planning, or project management is an advantage
• With at least 5 years of professional experience (ideally 10) you have successfully led hydropower and pumped storage planning projects and feasibility studies – experience with international projects is a plus
• Skilled in hydraulics, hydrology, geotechnics, structural design, and the integration of electrical and mechanical systems, you are familiar with international standards and financing requirements for hydropower projects
• You have experience in project management, contract negotiations, and proposal preparation; knowledge of construction supervision is an added advantage

• You are flexible, willing to travel internationally, and thrive in multicultural teams

In order to support our operations team, Airbus Operations is looking for an

Intern (d/f/m) for Business Management Support

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly organized, and motivated Business Management Support Intern (d/f/m) to join our operations team. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

As a Project Manager (f/m/d) Offshore Automation, you will lead complex international automation projects from the tender phase through engineering, execution, testing, commissioning, and final customer handover. You will be responsible for project delivery, including schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholder management, while driving standardization, operational excellence, and project profitability. In addition, you will leverage your automation expertise and project management experience to introduce digital tools, AI-supported ways of working, and modern collaboration methods that enhance project performance and execution quality.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* End-to-end responsibility for Offshore Automation sub-projects, including project execution, cost, schedule, quality, risk, and customer satisfaction
* Coordination and stakeholder management across customers, engineering, commissioning, suppliers, consortium partners, and international project teams
* Management of contractual, technical, commercial, and project-specific requirements to ensure alignment, compliance, and successful delivery
* Proactive governance of project risks, opportunities, claims, changes, and deviations throughout the entire project lifecycle
* Implementation of standardized and modular automation solutions to enhance quality, efficiency, scalability, and project profitability
* Continuous improvement of project execution through digital tools, data-driven transparency, AI-supported methods, and standardized processes, governance, and collaboration models

* Technical degree or professional qualification in Automation, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field; alternatively, substantial project management experience gained through vocational career paths
* Project Management Certification (e.g., PM@Siemens or IPMA) combined with extensive experience in managing complex technical projects in automation, energy, infrastructure, offshore, or comparable industries
* Expertise in international project management with multiple stakeholders, demanding customers, and complex execution interfaces
* Strong knowledge of automation and control systems, software-based solutions, engineering processes, testing, and commissioning activities
* Commercial and project governance competence, including budget management, cost forecasting, profitability control, as well as risk, claim, change, schedule, and resource management
* High international mobility, excellent English communication skills, and a collaborative, forward-thinking mindset with a strong interest in digitalization, AI, automation trends, and intercultural teamwork

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.
